Reference: https://www.erdosproblems.com/373
Imported from google-deepmind/formal-conjectures (`ErdosProblems/373.lean`, theorem `erdos_373`, AMS 11).

Show that the equation `n!=a_1!a_2!···a_k!`, with `n−1 > a_1 ≥ a_2 ≥ ··· ≥ a_k`, has
only finitely many solutions.

S.Finite
